Houthis claim strikes on Saudi Shaybah oilfield, Aramco Yanbu site and Riyadh and Abha airports
events.summary: Yemen's Houthis said they attacked Saudi energy, airport and military targets including the Shaybah oilfield, an Aramco site in Yanbu, King Khalid airport in Riyadh and Abha airport; Saudi damage was not confirmed in the report.

events.title: Sensex falls 876 points to 73,852 and Nifty closes at 22,888 as banks and crude weigh
events.summary: The Sensex closed down 876 points at 73,852 and the Nifty fell 257 points (1.1%) to 22,888, led by private banks such as Axis Bank and HDFC Bank, with weak earnings and high crude cited.

events.title: China Q3 GDP grows 4.5%, beating forecasts; September retail sales up 1.1%
events.summary: China's GDP grew 4.5% y/y in Q3 (poll 4.4%, Q2 4.3%) and 1.2% q/q; September retail sales rose 1.1% (poll 0.5%) and industrial output 5.5%, while Jan-Sep fixed-asset investment fell 7.2% and property investment 20.6%.

events.title: Rubio says US-India trade deal is near finalisation
events.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the US and India are close to finalising their trade agreement; the published framework cuts additional US duties on Indian goods from 25% to 18%.

events.title: Saudi Arabia to postpone in-person 'Davos in the Desert' after Houthi attacks
events.summary: The FT reported Saudi Arabia will postpone the in-person Future Investment Initiative after Houthi attacks; Fars separately reported sirens and an explosion in Riyadh the same hour.

events.title: MSCI launches consultation to reclassify Indonesia from Emerging to Standalone market
events.summary: MSCI proposed moving Indonesia from Emerging Market to Standalone status, saying a Frontier downgrade would not reflect the severity of its market problems; it expects to proceed unless governance clearly improves, with a final decision by end-June 2027 and the index freeze kept in place. Goldman earlier estimated a downgrade could trigger up to $13 billion of equity outflows.

events.title: MSCI freezes Turkey index changes and warns of possible downgrade from Emerging Market status
events.summary: MSCI imposed an interim freeze, effective immediately, on FIF and share-count increases, MSCI Turkey IMI additions and size-segment migrations over concerns about coordinated trading through fund holdings. It may consult on reclassifying Turkey to Frontier or Standalone if there is no progress by June 2027.

events.title: Euro falls and European stocks drop as French unrest and high energy prices weigh
events.summary: The euro slipped and the Stoxx index fell at the open as violent cost-of-living protests in France and high energy prices weighed on sentiment.

events.title: Trump waives some Russia sanctions, restrictions and energy-linked duties under the Graham Act
events.summary: Trump signed an executive order waiving application of certain sanctions, restrictions and duties under the Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act (signed Sept 18, initial measures due Oct 18) and certified to Congress that the waivers serve US national interests; Bloomberg says the waivers cover Russia energy tariffs.

events.title: India bonds give up the day's gains as oil price spike adds to rate-hike fears
events.summary: Indian government bonds erased early gains as higher crude prices revived concerns about an RBI rate hike.

events.title: Asian AI stocks crash: Kospi plunges about 8% triggering circuit breaker, Nikkei down about 5%
events.summary: After the hot US CPI, Korea's Kospi fell as much as 8.2% to 5,514.96, triggering a 20-minute circuit breaker (its 10th this year), while the Nikkei fell about 5% as AI and chip stocks tumbled amid AI financing worries including CoreWeave debt concerns.

events.title: Trump may decide in about 10 days on up to 100% tariffs on India over Russian oil
events.summary: A US sanctions law signed 18 September gives the president power to impose tariffs of up to 100% on Indian exports tied to Russian oil purchases, with a decision point around 18 October.

events.title: Jio Platforms IPO anchor book draws about ₹2.5 lakh crore of demand, nearly 30 times the quota
events.summary: The anchor portion of the record ₹30,213 crore Jio Platforms IPO drew about ₹2.5 lakh crore of bids (Reuters: nearly 30 times oversubscribed), with BlackRock, GIC and LIC among participants; public bidding runs October 21-23.

events.title: Longest chip selloff since 2006 hands short sellers $32 billion; Nasdaq falls 2%
events.summary: Chip stocks extended their longest losing streak since 2006, giving short sellers about $32 billion in paper gains, while the Nasdaq fell about 2% on Friday as doubts over AI returns deepened; chip-equipment stocks also posted historic losing streaks.

events.title: CoreWeave jumps on Goldman Sachs upgrade as AI stocks rebound; Nasdaq up over 1%
events.summary: CoreWeave shares jumped after a Goldman Sachs upgrade and AI-linked stocks recovered, lifting the Nasdaq more than 1% ahead of key earnings; Marvell rose 6% and Broadcom 3%.

events.title: PBOC governor: overnight reverse repo may become policy rate; new liquidity tool for non-bank redemptions
events.summary: PBOC Governor said China is weighing the overnight reverse repo rate as its policy rate, will launch a liquidity support tool for large-scale redemptions by non-bank institutions and will let more overseas institutions trade RMB in the onshore FX market.

events.title: South Korea's President Lee says a stock correction is inevitable after a sharp rally
events.summary: President Lee Jae-myung said a stock market correction is inevitable after the sharp rally and that it is difficult for the government to intervene.

events.title: Bajaj Finance Q2 net profit up 29% to ₹6,367 crore; NII up 24%
events.summary: Bajaj Finance reported September-quarter net profit of ₹6,367 crore, up 29% year on year, with net interest income up 24%.

events.title: China's yuan hits four-year high as strong GDP data ease stimulus concerns
events.summary: The yuan rose to a four-year high against the dollar after China's Q3 GDP grew 4.5%, beating forecasts; the PBOC also set a stronger midpoint fixing.

events.title: UltraTech Cement Q2 net profit up 21% to ₹1,494 crore; revenue up 19%
events.summary: UltraTech Cement reported a 21% year-on-year rise in second-quarter net profit to ₹1,494 crore on revenue growth of 19%.

events.title: Union Bank of India Q2 profit up 30%; shares jump 5%
events.summary: Union Bank of India shares rose 5% after Q2 net profit rose 30% year on year with improved asset quality, as PSU banks bucked a broad Indian market fall.

events.title: Nifty slips below 23,000 as Axis Bank and HDFC Bank drag; PSU bank index rises 3%
events.summary: The Sensex fell about 558 points and the Nifty slipped under 23,000 as Axis Bank fell up to 5% after Q2 results, while the Nifty PSU Bank index rose about 3% led by PNB.

events.title: Foreign portfolio investors pull ₹52,100 crore from Indian equities in October so far
events.summary: The Economic Times reported FPIs have withdrawn about ₹52,100 crore from Indian equities so far in October amid global headwinds; NSDL data cited by Angel One showed ₹47,417 crore through October 12, with 2026 outflows above ₹3 lakh crore.

events.title: Record ₹30,213 crore Jio Platforms IPO opens October 21 among ₹31,663 crore of offerings this week
events.summary: Jio Platforms' IPO (price band ₹1,065-1,119, about ₹30,213 crore at the top, India's largest) takes anchor bids on October 19 and opens October 21-23; nine listings worth ₹31,663 crore are lined up this week.
